requirements.quote: SRAA reserves the right to impose sanctions following a determination of non-compliance by a Contractor.
requirements.text: SRAA may impose sanctions for contractor non-compliance.

requirements.quote: Sanctions may be imposed upon the Contractor whenever EEO and/or MWBE program requirements have not been met in a timely and effective manner.
requirements.text: Sanctions apply if EEO or MWBE requirements are not met effectively.

requirements.quote: Disallowance of costs associated with such noncompliance;
requirements.text: Costs related to non-compliance may be disallowed.

requirements.quote: Initiation of procedures to suspend or terminate the grant or contract;
requirements.text: Procedures to suspend or terminate the contract may be initiated.

requirements.quote: Withholding of progress payments until such time as corrective actions have been undertaken by the Contractor to the satisfaction of SRAA;
requirements.text: Progress payments may be withheld until corrective actions are satisfactory.

requirements.quote: Deleting Contractor’s name from bid lists for a specified period of time to be determined in the sole discretion of SRAA;
requirements.text: Contractor may be removed from bid lists for a period.

requirements.quote: Report Contractor as non-responsible to NYS OSC Vendor Responsibility System;
requirements.text: Contractor may be reported as non-responsible to NYS OSC.

requirements.quote: Other sanctions of which a Contractor has notice in writing prior to or during the performance of a contract.
requirements.text: Other sanctions may be applied with prior written notice.
